raw.specification_text:
Scheme Name: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India (PM-YASASVI) - Pre-Matric Scholarship
Ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
Department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
Target Classes: Class 9, Class 10
Academic Requirement: Passed Class 8 examination from a recognized school; regular full-time student in Class 9 or 10.
School Type Requirement: Studying in Government schools only.
Annual Income Ceiling: Rs. 250000
Selection Mode: Direct / Merit
Financial Assistance:  - Rs. 4000 per annum
Registration Requirement: One Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar/EID on NSP
raw.faq_text:
Q: Who can apply for PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India (PM-YASASVI) - Pre-Matric Scholarship?
A: Eligible students studying in Class 9, Class 10.
Q: What is the official portal?
A: https://scholarships.gov.in
Q: Is OTR required for AY 2026-27?
A: Yes, One Time Registration is mandatory on National Scholarship Portal.

eligibility_summary.academic_requirement: Passed Class 8 examination from a recognized school; regular full-time student in Class 9 or 10.
eligibility_summary.social_category: Other Backward Classes (OBC), Economically Backward Classes (EBC), or De-Notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes (DNT/SNT) not covered under SC/ST.

benefits_summary.disbursement_frequency: Annual consolidated academic allowance via DBT

raw.inclusion_rationale: Centrally sponsored pre-matric scholarship explicitly targeted at Class 9 and 10 students from backward and disadvantaged communities in government schools.
